journey.name: local-only paykit fallback
journey.description: LOCAL-ONLY and unrun. Use the setup recipe in local-paykit-fallback.md only after actual remote Shop staging Paykit pairing fails and the staging homeserver signup prerequisite passes. This verifies a standalone Paykit fixture, not Shop order-paid or Locks content acceptance.

actions.action: Record the failed remote staging pairing evidence and successful homeserver signup prerequisite
Verify the pinned server revision, app binary, staging homeserver identities and matching regtest Electrum endpoint
Validate the owned server configuration, start the server and Cloudflare tunnel, and verify both health endpoints
Open the fixture setup page in a browser, send its generated Pubky Auth URL to the seller wallet, and verify Paykit access and watch-only account consent
Authorize the claims and verify setup completes for the original seller without sharing root identity or spending keys
Enable contact payments in both wallets, save both contacts and verify their linked state
Fund the fresh buyer staging-regtest savings address and verify the confirmed balance
Create exactly one fixture request and record its original payer, seller, request, invoice, amount, recipient, network and deadline
Verify the received request and payment review match those original values before authenticating
Authenticate the payment once and record the retained transaction identity and backend outcome
If the outcome is uncertain, retain the original guard and request without creating a replacement payment
Verify the exact transaction output and server payment observation, then mine and record confirmation
Report standalone pairing, delivery and payment results separately from the original Shop order, marking unexercised Shop acceptance unrun
Save sanitized evidence, classify incomplete boundaries and verify teardown of only owned resources while preserving unresolved recovery state
